messages:
yuri: Quick intake: partner wants a pen-test for staging next month. Need to set up an "escrow locker" for artifacts, lock RBAC edits, and ensure KMS proxy is sign-only. Who takes escrow owner?

mona: dates/scope? staging only? any external infra?

yuri: Window 2026-04-14 09:00 -> 2026-04-15 17:00 UTC. Staging + integration cluster. No prod. Includes S3 objects, runtime KMS sign/verify, auth flows.

adesh: I can own escrow locker + presigned path. Plan: s3://escrow-locker/partner-20260414/ . I'll create a presigned GET valid 7 days and a short-lived presigned PUT for our test uploads. Command I'll run: `./escrow-init --bucket escrow-locker --prefix partner-20260414 --retention 120d`

infra-bot: Ephemeral RBAC roles: will create OKTA-backed assessor role with TTL 4h scoped to `staging:*:read` and `kms-proxy:sign`. CLI: `./grant-temp-role assessor:partner --scopes staging:read,kms-proxy:sign --ttl 4h`

mona: KMS proxy must never allow decrypt. We'll expose `POST /kms-proxy/sign` and `POST /kms-proxy/verify`. Assessors get sealed ciphertext objects only.

yuri: Escrow format: gzipped tar `evidence-<partner>-YYYYMMDD.tar.gz` containing `audit/`, `configs/`, `objects/`, and `meta/`. Meta includes `manifest.csv` (columns: path,sha3_512,size,type,owner,export_tool_v) and `manifest.sig` (GPG) plus `manifest.ledger` with line-delimited proof entries.

adesh: Use sha3_512 for per-file checksum (we want a different hash algo than past engagements). We'll also include `meta/signing_key_fingerprint.txt`. Example manifest line: `objects/cloudtrail-20260414.ndjson,sha3_512:9f1a...,204800,audit,adesh,v1.2.0`

mona: KMS proxy logging fields required: timestamp,request_id,principal,operation,key_alias,payload_hash,response_code,authorization_hint,trace_id,duration_ms. Include `session_origin` to map to OKTA session id.

infra-bot: I'll enable exports for CloudTrail + internal audit stream for the engagement window. Exports will be snapshotted and stored in escrow. Retention policy set to 120 days.

yuri: Triage & retest gate: Critical/P0-P1 block retest until fixed+validated; High/P2 require mitigation + test plan + assigned owner; Medium/Low scheduled. If KMS/HSM impacted, require `kms_policy_before.json`, `kms_policy_after.json`, `repro_steps.md` and `patch_diff.patch`.

adesh: For artifact packaging, I'll also include a small `meta/checksums.sha3` file with `sha3_512` sums and a `meta/counts.csv` summarizing number of events per audit type (so assessors don't need to re-run heavy queries).

mona: Good. Also produce a short `meta/verify.md` that tells assessors how to verify the manifest signature and checksums (commands for gpg + sha3sum).

sec-audit-bot: calendar event created: "Partner Pen Test - Escrow Locker" 2026-04-14 09:00 -> 2026-04-15 17:00 UTC. Reminder set.

adesh: Dry-run proposed 2026-04-13 10:00 UTC. I'll test: presigned upload/download, manifest generation (sha3_512), GPG signing, KMS proxy sign-test and log capture.

yuri: Owners: yuri -> coordinator + triage doc; adesh -> escrow + presigned path + packaging; mona -> KMS proxy + logging schema; infra-bot -> roles + export snapshot.

mona: One more: exception flow for RBAC freeze. We'll gate any role edits with `./request-rbac-exception --ticket <URL>` and require dual approval from sec lead + infra lead. The exception will be logged to `meta/rbac_exceptions.log` and included in the bag.

adesh: I'll post the presigned test URL in this thread after dry-run. Also will upload a tiny sample evidence tar so team can review manifest layout.

yuri: Perfect. Thanks all — dry-run tomorrow 10:00 UTC. :white_check_mark:
